gen-flavors-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans keeps its small letters nearly as tall as its capitals, while Flavors lays down whimsical, marker-like strokes up top. Whole paragraphs of it read modern and unhurried.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-odia: Bold, widely spaced Goldman sets the tone up top. Anek Odia takes over below with clean, contemporary lowercase whose rounds stay open, so extended reading keeps moving along.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anuphan: Broad, bold strokes: Goldman sets its round forms like open parentheses, with generous clearance between every letter. Anuphan, with its big round bowls and clear gaps, keeps extended reading clean.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-arimo: Arimo reads tidy and unfussy, with a tall mean line and spacious gaps inside its rounded letters. Goldman earns its keep big and brief, a few bold words.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Commanding Goldman stretches its letters wide, with round forms like open parentheses. Carrois Gothic SC does the quieter job, keeping every curve open and capitals close to lowercase height.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-duru-sans: Wide, loud, and rounded: Goldman sets bold letters with generous clearance and a big lowercase against its capitals. Duru Sans makes extended reading feel open, modern, and clean.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-fresca: Wide, bold, and a bit imposing: that is Goldman. Fresca moves in beside it like neon tubing bent into letters, with short ascenders above big bowls and counters that stay open.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-funnel-sans: Loud, wide, and rounded, Goldman curves like open parentheses while Funnel Sans keeps its stroke widths steady. Long paragraphs set in Funnel Sans read crisp, clean, and tidy.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Goldman arrives wide, bold, and fully in charge. Hedvig Letters Sans does the gentler work, with a clear wide gap where the c ends and small letters nearly as tall as capitals.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen lets its small letters stand almost capital-sized, with curves that end in clear daylight beneath bold Goldman. Extended reading in it stays clean and relaxed, never crowded.
